answers.workaround:
Calling `super()` in GDscript doesn't work.

I can bypass this issue by using:

1. Other virtual functions, like `_enter_tree()`, however, this function also can be overridden in GDscript
2. Signals, however, I have to expose a function that I want to connect to signal to GDscript, sometimes I don't want to do it. In Addition, it messes up execution order.

title: Perform GDExtension C++ virtual functions calls before GDscript
